errors.text: The hypothesis does not identify the target AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA with its as-cast FCC+B2 microstructure, instead shifting to a broad refractory-HEA/precipitation system.
It substitutes D0a/D022 precipitates and precipitate coarsening for the target mediator: enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
The proposed 600-900°C or time-dependent aging regime does not reconstruct the approximately 550-750°C transition window, including peak embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The cited evidence does not establish a ductile-brittle-ductile aging transition or the required correlation between chemical-ordering intensity and minimum ductility.

The falsification experiment does not directly test crack initiation and dislocation pile-ups at jagged phase-boundary tips or exclude conventional impurity-segregation-driven intergranular embrittlement.
